name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement (spec first)
title: "[Feature] "

<!-- ReadGraph is spec-driven: features are implemented only after an agreed
     specification. See https://github.com/ckyOL/ReadGraph/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -->

**Problem**
What can't you do today? Describe the problem, not just a desired UI.

**Proposed behavior**
What should the app do once this feature exists?

**Spec / UI notes**
- Where does this fit in the app (import, library, detail page, profile, settings)?
- Layout / interaction details (only if you have them):
- Does it interact with existing specs in `docs/specs/`?

**Alternative approaches**
What else did you consider?

**Additional context**
Any references, screenshots (desensitized), or related issues.
